Glossary

Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Retrieval-augmented generation is a technique that pairs a vector index with a large language model. It is widely used in production AI assistants.

Vector index

A vector index refers to a data structure that maps embeddings to documents. It supports nearest-neighbour queries.

Embeddings

Embeddings denote dense floating-point representations of text or other media. They are produced by neural encoders.
